input: 14 hand-built VCF records on chromosome 21 of the release-116 GRCh37 cache: an intronic SNV, an intergenic SNV, single-base substitutions called synonymous (one lower-case), stop_lost, missense (one with two alternate alleles), start_lost and stop_gained on transcripts of both strands, a deletion, an insertion, a two-base substitution and a missense SNV the score file leaves out
